topic: App snapshot mode is an offscreen test target
detail: The app had no snapshot mode, so SP-072 adds the OrchAppSnapshots test target (Package.swift), which @testable-imports OrchApp and draws views offscreen with cacheDisplay when ORCH_SNAPSHOT_DIR is set; it is skipped otherwise, so CI writes nothing. Offscreen drawing does not show window chrome, focus or vibrancy exactly as on screen. Unverified assumption: GitHub's macos-26 runner keeps building the extra test target (it compiles but is skipped) within the app job's time. The user may want a fuller snapshot mode (every pane) later.
